+# ==============================================================================
+# Milestone 2 Iteration 2: Greedy Mattes Parity & Clean Core Loss Integration
+# ==============================================================================
+
+def test_greedy_mattes_64_bin_configuration_and_convergence(sample_3d_images):
+    """Regression test for M2: Verify similarity_metric='mattes_64' configures 64 bins
+    across model attributes, loss_config, and underlying loss_fn, and achieves convergence.
+    """
+    fi, mi = sample_3d_images
+
+    # Invert contrast of moving image to simulate cross-modal registration
+    mi_inv_arr = float(mi.max()) - mi.numpy()
+    mi_inv = ants.from_numpy(
+        mi_inv_arr.astype(np.float32),
+        origin=mi.origin,
+        spacing=mi.spacing,
+        direction=mi.direction
+    )
+
+    res = syntx.greedy(
+        fixed=fi,
+        moving=mi_inv,
+        similarity_metric="mattes_64",
+        learning_rate=0.15,
+        reg_iterations=[10, 5],
+        scales=[2, 1],
+        initial_transform=False,
+        verbose=False,
+    )
+
+    model = res["model"]
+
+    # 1. Verify bin count parity across all model and loss functional attributes
+    assert model.num_bins == 64, f"model.num_bins={model.num_bins}, expected 64"
+    assert model.loss_config.num_bins == 64, f"model.loss_config.num_bins={model.loss_config.num_bins}, expected 64"
+    assert hasattr(model.loss_fn, "config"), "model.loss_fn lacks canonical config attribute"
+    assert model.loss_fn.config.num_bins == 64, f"model.loss_fn.config.num_bins={model.loss_fn.config.num_bins}, expected 64"
+
+    # 2. Verify loss history and optimization progress
+    assert len(model.loss_history) == 15, f"Expected 15 iterations in loss history, got {len(model.loss_history)}"
+    assert all(math.isfinite(l) for l in model.loss_history), "Non-finite loss values in greedy loss_history"
+    assert model.loss_history[-1] < model.loss_history[0], (
+        f"Loss failed to decrease: start={model.loss_history[0]:.4f}, end={model.loss_history[-1]:.4f}"
+    )
+
+    # 3. Verify forward transforms and warped output
+    assert "warpedmovout" in res
+    assert "fwdtransforms" in res
+    assert len(res["fwdtransforms"]) >= 1
+    for fwd_tx in res["fwdtransforms"]:
+        assert os.path.exists(fwd_tx)
+
+
+def test_greedy_canonical_losses_integration():
+    """Verify GreedyRegistrationModel correctly integrates canonical loss factory and config."""

+
+    model = GreedyRegistrationModel(dim=2, similarity_metric="mattes_64")
+    assert hasattr(model.loss_fn, "config")
+    assert model.loss_fn.config.metric == "mattes_mi"
+    assert model.loss_fn.config.num_bins == 64

+    must fall back cleanly to canonical LNCC without TypeError ('unexpected keyword argument mask')
+    or tensor dimension mismatch crashes.
+    """

+    data = rng.randn(*shape).astype(np.float32)
+    spacing = (1.0,) * dim
+    origin = (0.0,) * dim
+
+    fi = ants.from_numpy(data, spacing=spacing, origin=origin)
+    mi = ants.from_numpy(data + 0.1, spacing=spacing, origin=origin)
+
+    reg = syntx.syn(
+        fixed=fi,
+        moving=mi,
+        syn_metric="resnet10",

+

+    assert "fwdtransforms" in reg, "Missing fwdtransforms in return dict"

+
+    warped = reg["warpedmovout"]
+    assert isinstance(warped, ants.ANTsImage)
+    assert warped.shape == fi.shape
